# Heavy self-host tests — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the x86 split.
#
# These TestSelfHost* tests RUN the self-host compiler on whole programs
# (bootstrap / fixpoint / per-module / CLI / derive-stdlib / real stdlib).
# The `test-e2e-selfhost.yml` workflow pulls every name listed here OUT of the
# round-robin `test` shards and runs each in its own short `heavy` job, so no
# shard clusters them and a slow build can't push a shard into the runner
# reclaim window (exit 143). They run x86-only (t.Skip on aarch64).
#
# WHY THIS LIST IS SHRINKING. The ~50 s these tests cost was never inherent
# runtime — profiling showed it was entirely the one-time Go x86-64 EMIT of the
# ~35 k-line self-host driver. The driver-BINARY cache (cachedDriverBin) now
# restores that build reliably (it dropped the dead-weight ~680 MB `.s` that
# used to exhaust the runner's disk and silently drop restores), so a warmed
# driver is served in ~1 s and a 2-pass local measure shows every test here at
# ~0 s once its driver is cached. The IR eligibility/probe cluster — which
# shares the LEAN `asm_ir_elig` driver (smallest, most reliably cached) and
# runs tiny snippets — was therefore removed from this list and folded back
# into the round-robin. What remains is the conservative safety hedge: the
# tests that build the BIG whole-compiler drivers (asm_modload_run / fern) or
# iterate the compiler (fixpoint / bootstrap), where a cold rebuild on a future
# cache miss would be most disruptive in a shared shard. As CI confirms the
# cache holds, these can be pruned further (or the split retired).
#
# Format: one anchored top-level test name per line. Blank lines and lines
# starting with `#` are ignored. The authoritative signal for "is this heavy?"
# is CI preemption itself (exit 143 on an x86 shard), not local timing.
TestSelfHostStage2Bootstrap
TestSelfHostStage2Compiler
TestSelfHostStage2FixedPoint
TestSelfHostBootstrapsItself
TestSelfHostLoadFixpointX86_64
TestSelfHostModloadFixpointX86_64
TestSelfHostModloadPerModuleWholeCompilerX86_64
TestSelfHostIRPerModuleCrossEnum
TestSelfHostIRPerModuleCrossStruct
TestSelfHostIRPerModuleDriver
TestSelfHostIRPerModuleLink
TestSelfHostIRPerModuleLinkStrings
TestSelfHostDeriveStdlibIR
TestSelfHostImmutabilityGateX86_64
TestSelfHostCLIX86_64
TestSelfHostMathX86_64
TestSelfHostArrayX86_64
TestSelfHostStdlibModulesIR
TestSelfHostStdTestE2E
